content:
Ellen (Partnerships): Quick heads-up  Sapphire Insurance signed a 3yr Dedicated commitment, plus an ISV listing on Azure Marketplace. They're also starting a Private VPC pilot for EU-regulated lines. Planning public launch tomorrow AM. :tada:
Tao (Sales): Amazing  huge congrats team. Who's owning the case study and the quote?
Priya (Marketing): I can run the case study. Need: a 1-line quote (<=120 chars), 2-sentence customer profile, and a high-res logo by EOD today so we can hit the newsletter.
Marco (Solutions): Infra notes: dedicated GPU pool provisioned in eu-west2, pinned model -> `rwd-mistral-7b-q4`, canary 5% -> 50% over 90m. KV cache priming scheduled at 23:30 UTC. Enabling audit logs to their KMS.
Javier (Finance): Contract countersigned  3yr commit, $1.05M ARR. PO expected next week. Billing contact: ap@getsapphire.com. Include enterprise SLA per SOW.
Ellen (Partnerships): Sapphire legal approved a short quote: "Redwood delivered private, predictable inference for our regulated insurance workflows." They're fine with co-branded posts and a short CTO clip. Assets coming in ~1 hour.
MarketplaceBot: Azure Marketplace publish complete  listing: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/apps/sapphire-insurance-redwood (id: az-0xB88). Indexing may take ~20-40 mins.
Tao (Sales): Are we good to co-brand social? Also need the 1-line summary for the marketplace card.
Ellen (Partnerships): Co-branding approved. Marketplace blurb in drive: "Sapphire Insurance + Redwood  secure, low-latency inference for regulated insurance workflows." Logo in /partners/sapphire_insurance/brand.zip.
Priya (Marketing): Draft announcement uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/sapphire-launch.md. Will queue social for 9am CET if assets arrive. Can someone capture a 30s CTO soundbite?
Marco (Solutions): I can run a 20-min tech interview and extract a 30s clip. Also posting perf checklist: 1) warm KV 2) smoke perf 3) canary ramp 4) verify audit log delivery. Will post p50/p95 after smoke.
OnboardBot: Onboarding ticket ONB-11567 created. SRE runbook attached.
Javier (Finance): FYI the deal includes a quarterly billing cadence. Please loop finance for any scope changes.
Priya (Marketing): Shoutout to @Ellen and @Marco. I'll finalize the case study once I have the quote and logo.
Ellen (Partnerships): Assigning owners: @Priya - case study + comms; @Marco - CTO clip + perf; @Javier - billing/PO follow-up. Final launch note will go out after marketplace indexing completes. :rocket:
